# AI Data Sources

## AI Data Sources Overview

**Does Chatty automatically sync my shipping policy, About us, or other store pages?** Yes — Chatty auto-syncs these Shopify store pages with no manual re-sync needed: Shipping policy, Return policy, Privacy policy, Terms of service, FAQ, Contact us, and About us. If a merchant updates one of these pages, the AI picks up the change automatically. No action required.

Data sources are the information you provide to train your AI agent. The AI uses this data to give accurate, personalized responses about your products, services, and policies.

> **The four store sources start switched off.** Products, Collections, Discounts and FAQs are each
> synced into Chatty automatically — but the AI is **not allowed to use any of them until the store
> turns that source on** under **AI agent → Training data**. Syncing and using are
> two separate things, and only the syncing happens on its own.
>
> This is the single most common cause of *"the AI doesn't know my products"*, *"it makes answers
> up"*, or *"it says it can't find anything"*. Always check which sources are switched on before
> looking at anything else — a store can have thousands of products synced and an AI that is not
> permitted to read one of them.

**Store data (auto-synced):**
- Products: descriptions, variants, pricing, availability, inventory status, metafields
- Discounts: all active and inactive discounts from Shopify
- Markets: market settings including currency and exchange rates
- FAQs: your existing FAQs in Chatty

**Custom data sources (manually added):**
- Questions (Q&A pairs)
- URLs (website links — content is scraped and indexed)
- Files (.JSON, .TXT, .PDF, .CSV — max 2MB for AI training data; images and PDFs with tables not yet supported)

**Auto-synced Shopify pages:** Shipping policy, Return policy, Privacy policy, Terms of service, FAQ, Contact us, About us. These sync automatically — no manual action needed.

Product information updates daily at **00:00 UTC**. To sync sooner, trigger a manual resync in **AI agent → Training data → Products → Sync products**.

**What "product training" actually does:** Chatty simply **reads** the product data — title, description, price, variants — so the AI can answer questions about it. It does not modify, publish, or unpublish anything in the merchant's store.

---

## Adding & Managing Data Sources

Go to **AI agent** → **Training data**.

Training data is organized into 5 tabs since the **02/09/2026 Knowledge base restructure**:

- **Products** — enable/disable products for AI training, manage metafields, sync manually
- **Collections** — enable/disable collections; synced automatically with products
- **Discounts** — discount codes and automatic discounts from Shopify; auto sync daily
- **Markets** — market settings, currencies, exchange rates from Shopify
- **Knowledge base** — replaces the old separate **FAQs** and **Custom knowledge** tabs; see *Knowledge Base Tab* below for what changed.

After adding data, click **Test AI** (top right) to verify AI responds correctly.

**Bulk management:** Select multiple items for bulk actions: set as active, set as inactive, or delete.

---

## Knowledge Base Tab — Unified FAQs + Custom Knowledge (02/09/2026)

**Before 02/09/2026**, FAQ content and custom training content (Q&As, URLs, files) lived in two
separate tabs under **AI agent → Training data**: **FAQs** and **Custom knowledge**. This made it
hard to tell which entries the AI was actually using.

**As of 02/09/2026**, both are merged into a single **Knowledge base** tab
(**AI agent → Training data → Knowledge base**), listing every item — synced FAQs, manually added
Q&As, URLs, and files — in one table.

**Per-item status — three states instead of a plain on/off:**
- **Set live** — the AI is allowed to use this item.
- **Move to draft** — kept in the table but the AI does not use it yet (useful for content that
  isn't ready).
- **Turn off** — excluded from AI training.

**FAQs synced from the storefront (via the FAQ Builder) start on Draft, not Live** — they don't
automatically become AI training content just because they're published on the storefront FAQ
page. A merchant has to manually **Set live** a synced FAQ before the AI will use it. This is a
common cause of "I published this FAQ, why doesn't the AI know it?" after 02/09.

**Sync FAQs button runs in the background** — pulling in FAQ Builder content is no longer a
blocking action; the merchant can navigate away and the sync keeps running, with progress visible
when they come back.

**Duplicate content is never silently skipped:** if new content (e.g. a re-synced FAQ or a
re-uploaded file) matches something already in the Knowledge base, the merchant is prompted to
choose **Create new**, **Merge**, or **Replace** — it does not just drop the duplicate.

**FAQs synced from the store do not count toward the plan's data-source limit.** Only manually
added Q&As, URLs, and files count against the limit — see the CSV/file limits above.

**Content-quality banner:** the Knowledge base table shows a banner nudge when an item is **too
short, too long, or older than 90 days**, prompting the merchant to review/refresh it — this is a
suggestion, not a block; a flagged item still stays Live/Draft/Off as set.

---

## Smart Recommendations Setup

Tell AI which products to recommend in specific situations:

1. Go to **AI agent → Skills → Shopping → Smart recommendations**
2. Select a collection to manage
3. Set up product list and keywords
4. Click **Add product** to add items, **Delete** to remove
5. Click **Save** and activate the recommendation

**System recommendations** (pre-configured, always available):
- **Best sellers** — AI suggests when customers ask "What's popular?" Enable **Activate smart syncing** to auto-select top products based on sales, or add products manually.
- **New arrivals** — AI suggests when customers ask "What's new?" Enable **Activate smart syncing** to auto-populate, or add products manually.

**Custom recommendations** (create your own):
- **Sale promotion** — triggers when customers mention "sale", "discount", "deal". Set search terms + product conditions (add by product or by collection).
- **Special occasions** — triggers when customers mention "gift", "birthday", "anniversary". Set search terms + product conditions.
- Click **Add recommendation** to create additional custom types.

---

## Managing Individual Products

After syncing products:
1. Go to **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Products** tab
2. Set each product's status to **Enabled** or **Disabled**

Only published, in-stock products work with Chatty. Product subscriptions are not supported.

**Add product-specific FAQs (AI training data):**
1. Click **Products** tab
2. Click **Add FAQs** or **Manage FAQs** on a specific product
3. Type each question and answer yourself

These FAQs teach the **AI agent** about that product — they are training data. Write them
manually; the AI-generate option produces FAQs for the store as a whole, not per product.

> To display a different set of FAQs on each **product page of the storefront**, this is the
> wrong tool. Use **FAQs** → **FAQs block**: create a block per product or group, select the
> questions, and set the display condition to **Product pages → by collection/tag**.
> See `faq_faqs-block`.

## Troubleshooting File & URL Training

- **CSV import shows questions as "Failed":** this is usually because the topic was set to **Published but not Active**. Set the topic **Active**, fix the file, and re-upload. If the app won't let you delete the failed rows, contact support to clear them.
- **Adding a website URL only trains the homepage:** entering the **domain alone** trains the AI on the homepage only. To train on specific content, add the **individual page URLs** (e.g. `/pages/avada-faqs`). The AI does **not** auto-scrape your whole site — you choose what to feed it.
- **File limits:** PDF, CSV, TXT, JSON, **max 2 MB each**; CSV is best for structured Q&A. Images and PDFs whose content is in tables/scans may not be parsed — re-enter that data as text.
- **URL/file training stuck "In Progress" or "Failed":** delete and re-add one at a time — a common cause is the source page being **password-protected**, which blocks the crawler (Shopify's own Shipping/Return/FAQ pages are exempt since those are synced directly, not crawled). Workaround: paste the content into a supported file (PDF/CSV/TXT/JSON, 2MB max) and upload under **Custom knowledge → Add data → Files** instead.

# Chatty — Knowledge Base

## Product Overview

Chatty is a Shopify app that helps merchants communicate with store visitors via live chat, automate customer support with an AI chatbot (built on a secure, enterprise-grade large language model), and build self-serve FAQ help centers. Chatty is designed as an AI-first chat platform specifically for eCommerce stores, turning customer conversations into sales opportunities.

Built for Shopify badge. Available on Shopify App Store. 4.9 stars with 1,700+ reviews.

## Plans

| Feature | Free | Basic ($19.99/mo) | Pro ($68.99/mo) | Plus ($199/mo) |
|---------|------|--------------------|------------------|---------------------|
| AI conversations | 50/month | 100/month | 500/month | 1,000/month |
| Additional conversations | N/A | $0.40 each | $0.40 each | $0.40 each |
| Products for AI training | 200 | 500 | 8,000 | 20,000 |
| Team members | 1 | 5 | 10 | Unlimited |
| Auto-translation languages | 1 | 2 | 9 | Unlimited |
| Chat history | 90 days | 12 months | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Email channel | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Smart product recommendations | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| CSAT survey | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Cart booster | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Dedicated AI consultant | No | No | No | Yes |

Annual billing: ~15% savings. 7-day free trial for paid plans. 30-day money-back guarantee.

## Core Features

### Live Chat
Real-time messaging between merchants and store visitors. Key capabilities:
- **Inbox**: Unified inbox to manage all conversations. Includes customer details panel, conversation details, chat zone with rich text editor.
- **Channels**: Email, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp — all synced into one inbox.
- **Contacts**: Customer management with tags, notes, and conversation history.
- **Team**: Invite team members, assign roles, manage conversation assignments.
- **Quick Replies**: Pre-saved response templates for faster replies.
- **Proactive Chat**: Behavior-triggered messages to engage visitors (e.g., time on page, specific page visit).
- **Real-time Translation**: Auto-translate messages between merchant and customer languages.

### AI agent
AI-powered chatbot that handles customer questions 24/7, trained on the merchant's store data:
- **AI Conversations**: Automatic responses to customer questions. AI shows as assignee in conversation details. Team can join AI conversations at any time.
- **Chat Summary**: When conversation transfers to human, AI summarizes the full conversation with language detection, issue highlights, and response suggestions.
- **Training data** (**AI agent → Training data**):
  - *Store data* (auto-synced): Products (name, description, variants, pricing, inventory, metafields), discounts, markets, policies (shipping, return, privacy, terms).
  - **Knowledge base tab** (since 02/09/2026, replaces the old separate FAQs + Custom knowledge tabs): every FAQ and custom content item (Q&As, URLs, files — .JSON, .TXT, .PDF, .CSV, max 2MB) in one table, each set to **Live** (AI uses it), **Draft** (kept but not used yet), or **Off**. FAQs synced from the storefront start on Draft and don't count toward the plan's data-source limit. See `faq_data-sources` for full detail.
  - Products sync daily at 00:00 UTC. Only published, in-stock products are trained.
- **Skills** (**AI agent → Skills**) — what the AI is allowed to do, grouped in two sections:
  - *Shopping*: Smart recommendations (formerly "Product recommendations" — bestsellers, new arrivals, sales, special occasions, auto top 20 by sales, updated daily), Size guide (upload images, per-product assignment), inventory status.
  - *Customer support*: Human agent transfer (the same setting the Scenarios page calls **Human handover**), refund/return form, order tracking in chat.
- **Scenarios** (**AI agent → Scenarios**) — its own top-level page, no longer nested under Instructions. Holds the default scenarios (Human handover, After-sales support, Size guide, Product recommendations) plus any **custom scenario** the merchant adds. Skills toggle a capability on/off; Scenarios is where its wording and rules are edited.
- **Instructions** (**AI agent → Instructions**): General instructions — Role, Behaviours, tone and boundaries (~1,000-character cap).
- **Settings** (**AI agent → Settings**): Bot name, avatar, welcome message, AI availability (based on team online hours), AI channels, contact support email.
- **Test & Optimize**: Test zone to preview AI responses before going live. Review unresolved questions to improve training.

### Chatbox
The chat widget displayed on the merchant's storefront:
- **Chatbox mode** (since 26–27/08/2026): the chatbox comes in two selectable modes — **AI Mode** (AI-first, opens straight into chat with **Recommend For You** + **Commonly Asked** sections) and **Legacy chatbox** (the block-based home screen). A mode change only applies after **Save**. **Display chatbox on your store** is the master toggle above the picker.
- **Legacy chatbox → General**: chat focus mode, header (logo, heading, description), welcome message + conversation starter, and blocks (Live chat, Contact, Order tracking, FAQs, Categories).
- **Legacy chatbox → Appearance**: Brand colors (preset or custom), chatbox button (launcher icon, size, **Position** — anchor + offsets), chatbox style (navigation mode, mobile ratio).
- **AI Mode → General / Appearance**: suggested sections (Recommend For You, Commonly Asked) and brand colors + button icon/expand messages. **No Position control on AI Mode** — escalate reposition requests from AI Mode stores.
- **Shared chatbox settings** (applies to both modes, replaces the old **Advanced** and Chat-page fields): pre-chat form, deep links, embedded chatbox, display rules (devices, pages), custom CSS, continue-as-email, chat avatar.
- **Contact Button**: Add contact methods — supports 11 methods: WhatsApp, Messenger, Phone, Email, Instagram, Telegram, Skype, Line, Zalo, TikTok, SMS.
- **Embedded Chatbox**: Embed chatbox directly in page content instead of floating widget.

### FAQ Builder
Build a self-serve knowledge hub:
- **Categories**: Organize questions into categories with icons and descriptions.
- **Questions**: Add questions with rich text answers, assign to categories.
- **FAQs Page**: Dedicated FAQ page on the storefront with customizable theme.
- **FAQs Block**: Show selected FAQs inside the chatbox.
- **FAQs Analytics**: Track views, clicks, and search queries.
- **Export**: Export questions as CSV file.
- **Translation**: Translate FAQs into multiple languages.

### Order Tracking
Customers can track orders directly in the chatbox. Supports Shopify order tracking and third-party tracking integrations.

### Mobile & Web App
- **Mobile App**: Manage conversations on the go (iOS/Android). Receive push notifications for new messages.
- **Web App**: Browser-based admin dashboard at app.chatty.net.

### Integrations
- **Klaviyo**: Sync customer data (contacts, tags, conversation counts, timestamps) to Klaviyo for targeted email/SMS campaigns. Requires Klaviyo API key with Read/Write access for Lists and Profiles.
- **Zendesk**: Connect Zendesk for unified helpdesk management.
- **Joy Loyalty**: Show loyalty data (points, tier) in customer conversations.
- **Air Reviews**: Connect product reviews for AI training context.
- **Powerful Contact Form**: Integrate contact form submissions.
- **Website**: Connect external website for AI data training.

### Notifications
Configure notification preferences for new messages, assignments, and other events.

### Analytics
Track conversation metrics, AI performance, response times, and customer satisfaction.

### Online Hours
Set business hours to control online/offline status. Affects chatbox display and AI availability settings.

### Translation
Translate app interface and FAQs into multiple languages. Number of languages depends on plan.

### General Settings
App-wide configuration: branding, defaults, display preferences.

## Channel Details

### Email Channel
- Connect one email to Chatty via email forwarding.
- Default sender: noreply@chattyemail.com (customizable with domain verification).
- "Continue as email" feature lets customers switch from live chat to email.
- Conversation history sent to customer when ticket is marked solved.

### Facebook Messenger & Instagram
- Connect via Facebook account — link fanpages to sync messages.
- Messages appear in Chatty inbox with platform icon indicators.
- Disconnecting doesn't remove existing conversations.

### WhatsApp
- Connect multiple WhatsApp accounts.
- Requires: Business Facebook page, WhatsApp Business account linked to that page, admin access to both.

## Key Terminology

| Term | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| AI conversation | A customer chat handled by AI agent |
| Transfer | When AI hands off conversation to a human agent |
| Data source | Information used to train the AI (products, FAQs, custom data) |
| AI skill | Specialized capability for AI (recommendations, size guide, etc.) |
| Chatbox | The chat widget displayed on the storefront |
| Deep link | URL that opens a specific chatbox section directly |
| Proactive chat | Automated messages triggered by visitor behavior |
| Quick reply | Pre-saved response template for faster messaging |
| Contact button | Floating button with multiple contact method options |
| CSAT | Customer Satisfaction survey (Pro+ plans) |
| Smart recommendations | AI-powered product suggestions based on collections |

## Common Issues

- **Chatbox not showing on store**: Check that **Display chatbox on your store** is on (the master toggle at the top of the **Chatbox** page), app embed is enabled in the Shopify theme editor, and display rules aren't excluding the page (**Chatbox → Shared chatbox settings → Display rules**).
- **AI not responding**: Verify the AI agent is turned on, training data is synced, and the AI has enough content to answer from. On **Legacy chatbox**, also check the **Live chat** block at **Chatbox → Chatbox mode → Legacy chatbox → General → Blocks**; **AI Mode** has no blocks, so skip that step there.
- **Email channel not connecting (Outlook)**: Organization's Outlook settings may block automatic email forwarding. Contact IT admin to allow email forwarding.
- **Online status not showing**: the **Contact** block must be enabled — **Chatbox → Chatbox mode → Legacy chatbox → General → Blocks → Contact** (Legacy chatbox only; **AI Mode** has no blocks).
- **WhatsApp not connecting**: Ensure you have a Business Facebook page, WhatsApp Business account linked to it, and admin access to both accounts.
- **Translation not showing on store**: Website must support the language first. In Shopify Admin > Settings > Languages, add and publish the language before enabling it in Chatty.
- **AI recommending wrong products**: Check the Smart recommendations collections at **AI agent → Skills → Shopping → Smart recommendations**. Disable smart sync if auto-selected products aren't relevant. Manually curate product lists.
- **FAQ page not showing after uninstall/reinstall**: After uninstalling, Chatty's code may remain disabled. Check Shopify Admin > Online Store > Pages for orphaned FAQ pages.
- **Order tracking not working**: On **Legacy chatbox**, ensure the **Order tracking** block is on at **Chatbox → Chatbox mode → Legacy chatbox → General → Blocks**. On **AI Mode** there is no block — the customer asks the AI to track an order in chat. Verify Shopify order tracking info is properly set up.
- **Products not appearing in AI training**: Only published, in-stock products are trained. Products sync daily at 00:00 UTC. Check product count against plan limit.

## Privacy & Compliance

- **AI Compliance**: Chatty's AI follows data privacy standards. Customer conversation data is used only for AI training within the merchant's store scope.
- **Cookie Policy**: Chatty uses cookies for session management and chatbox functionality.
- **Data Access**: App accesses customer data (names, emails, addresses, browsing behavior), store owner info, product catalogs, orders, and discounts to function.
